scope: Retained-evidence reads only: source.* inventory entries (35 records, controller updates 0..34; one_step_predictions, applied_tensions, saved_projected_states, plan_selection, solver_status, controller_horizon, backend_motion derived views) plus the common baseline replay summary and configured controller parameters.
Report and observation only: no saved-state numerical work, no local solves or prediction evaluations (numerical_budget local_solves 0, prediction_evaluations 0).
Excluded: production configuration changes and backend execution; complete_execution capability is not exercised here (defer/reject leaves that allowance unused).
Frame note: tip vectors in world frame, projected GVS coordinates for state; a sampled view does not establish absence of unread subsets.
stopping_conditions: Stop when the sampled backend tip position/speed profile across the final 0.05 s settle window has been read for the latest controller updates and its limit exceedances are stated as observed amounts.
Stop when the terminal reach result and the sampled settling result are reported as recorded, without asserting a dominant cause or a causal link between timing and residual motion.

Stop when solver-status, plan-selection, and effective_horizon records are reported as recorded, and any unread or unretained channel is labeled not_displayed, not_read in this context, not_retained, or unavailable through a named capability.

Stop if answering would require saved-state numerical checks, closed-loop counterfactual replay, or historical full plans/optimizer traces that the inventory marks as not retained (control_snapshots.json).
